query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 75,
  radar_freshness = 35,
  radar_warmth = 70,
  radar_sweetness = 45,
  radar_spiciness = 40,
  radar_earthiness = 65
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%résine%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%resin%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%balsam%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%encens%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%myrrhe%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%frankincense%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
